title: Bleeding cut
whenToUse: A bleeding cut or limb bleed that you can reach yourself.

steps.text: Press firmly and steadily with clean cloth or gauze.
steps.caution: Do not lift the cloth early to check.

steps.text: If blood soaks through, add another cloth on top and keep pressing.
Apply tourniquet above the wound, not on a joint. Tighten until bleeding stops.
steps.detail: Use a commercial tourniquet if available when severe arm or leg bleeding does not stop with firm direct pressure.

steps.text: For a minor cut, rinse with clean water and cover with sterile dressing.

redFlags: Blood is spurting or will not stop with firm pressure.
You feel dizzy, confused, or cold and sweaty.
The wound is deep or on your chest, neck or groin.

escalation.text: Red flag or getting worse? Alert a crewmate now. Do not wait for Earth.
